0022600088.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons as the Raptors host the Bulls, with Toronto missing Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot), and Chicago missing Dailyn Swain (illness), Jordan Hawkins (illness), and Nic Claxton (hamstring). Toronto won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 139-109 win in Chicago on March 18, 2026. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet.
